§6Neutral Exotic Containment§f

§aThe antimatter safe. Stores antimatter without blowing up your base.§f

The Exotic Containment Chamber is built on a Vacuum Chamber hull and uses BSCCO coils and Osmiridium to maintain a magnetic trap. Antimatter cells can be loaded inside for safe storage, or antiproton plus positron inputs can synthesize antimatter directly.

The hull is 5x5x5 to 7x7x7 interior. Coils on the inside walls, beam ports for input, energy ports for power, fluid ports for cooling. The controller needs an Elite Processor.

Without this chamber, antimatter cells will detonate on contact with normal matter. Do not skip the containment step.

§cWARNING:§f If the magnetic field fails, antimatter touches the walls. You do not want to know what happens next.
